summary: SQLite rebuild failed because LIVE_20230314_001 segments existed both in the legacy pilot_alignment_b001 aggregate and the migrated per-live file.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 34705795869 failed with UNIQUE constraint failed: live_segments.live_id, live_segments.segment_index while inserting pilot_alignment_b001.jsonl record 4.
data/live_segments/alignment/LIVE_20230314_001.jsonl contains the same two L009 segment identities that were still present in pilot_alignment_b001.jsonl.
resolution_notes: Removed only the two L009 rows already migrated to the per-live file. Unmigrated legacy rows remain in the aggregate so no source data is lost. Future per-live migrations must remove/retire the corresponding legacy rows rather than leaving duplicate source-of-truth records.
